posts.text:
On the eve of @NATO summit, Polish FM @sikorskiradek tells me US troop reductions are “clearly coming” for Europe:

“Reductions are clearly coming, and the U.S. Is requiring us in Europe to have more conventional capabilities and for the U.S. to be more of a cavalry over the hill.”

Video
posts.summary: Reports U.S. troop reductions in Europe expected, framed as policy shift
